description: Produce a full post-mortem of one sent campaign: summary metadata, delivery and performance rates, engagement velocity (time-to-first-open and hourly engagement), audience quality, and per-variant breakdown when the campaign is an A/B test. Combines the detail, velocity, audience-quality and variate views into one report. All metrics come from synced BigQuery tables, so they are only as current as the project last sync run.

botFilter.description: Filter out members whose interactions appear to be automated bot activity. Select 'suspected-bot' for only bots, 'clean' to exclude bots, or 'all' (default) to ignore.

campaignId.description: The opaque string identifier for the campaign as assigned by Mailchimp. List campaigns to obtain this ID. If the ID is invalid or does not exist in the project, the endpoint will return a 404 error.

projectId.description: Required. The opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters to scope this request to. Call GET /_api/public/v1/enterprise/projects to list the project IDs available to your API key. Omitting it returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.
